gaps.sentence: She was ___ (GRATE) for all their support.
The vaccine gives ___ (PROTECT) against three strains.
gaps.explanation: 'Gives protection against' — the noun is required.

gaps.sentence: They're ___ (HOPE) that the talks will resume.
gaps.explanation: 'Be hopeful that…' = feeling hope; 'hopefully' is the adverb.

gaps.sentence: She gazed at the mural in silent ___ (ADMIRE).
gaps.explanation: 'In silent admiration' — the noun for the feeling.

gaps.sentence: He's an ___ (ENTHUSIASM) supporter of the team.
The committee's ___ (DECIDE) was announced this morning.
The ___ (IMPORTANT) of sleep is often ignored.

gaps.explanation: 'Appealed for calm' — the set phrase uses 'calm' as noun.
